declarations.name: Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.compact_source_support
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M] [ChartedSpace Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E M]
[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(anchor : M) (F : Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.E → Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.Bilin), HasCompactSupport F → tsupport F ⊆ (extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor).target →
IsCompact (Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.sourceSupport anchor F) ∧ Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.sourceSupport anchor F ⊆ (extChartAt (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) anchor).source ∧
(∀ x : M, x ∉ Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.sourceSupport anchor F → Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x = 0) ∧
IsCompact (closure {x : M | Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x ≠ 0}) ∧ closure {x : M | Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F x ≠ 0} ⊆ Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.sourceSupport anchor F ∧
∀ x : M, x ∉ Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.sourceSupport anchor F → Filter.Eventually (fun y => Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift anchor F y = 0) (nhds x)
